content.value_statement: ML teams need repeatable pipelines that connect data preparation, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through practical MLOps workflow design.
actual_capabilities: Outlines end-to-end ML pipeline stages from ingestion to monitoring.
Explains DAG orchestration patterns for Airflow, Dagster, Kubeflow, and Prefect.
Guides data validation, feature engineering, dataset versioning, and lineage planning.
Covers training orchestration, experiment tracking, and distributed training patterns.
Describes model validation, regression checks, A/B testing, and approval workflows.
Summarizes shadow, canary, blue-green, rollback, and monitoring deployment strategies.
limitations: Does not run pipelines, install tools, or provision cloud infrastructure.
Does not include complete runnable project code in the scanned skill file.
Requires users to adapt guidance to their stack, data, and compliance rules.
Does not replace security, privacy, or model risk review.

use_cases.title: Turn experiments into workflows
use_cases.description: Convert an experimental notebook into a staged training and validation workflow.

use_cases.title: Design production model operations
use_cases.description: Plan orchestration, deployment, rollback, and monitoring patterns for production models.

use_cases.title: Compare MLOps architecture options
use_cases.description: Evaluate pipeline tools and rollout practices before selecting an implementation approach.

prompt_templates.title: Map a Basic Pipeline
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a new project.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a simple machine learning pipeline for [use case]. Include data ingestion, training, validation, deployment, and monitoring stages.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Orchestration Tools
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Airflow, Dagster, Kubeflow, and Prefect for my ML workflow. My constraints are [team size, cloud, latency, governance].

prompt_templates.title: Design Validation Gates
prompt_templates.prompt: Design validation gates for a model release. Include data quality checks, baseline comparison, approval criteria, rollback triggers, and reports.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Production MLOps Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a production MLOps workflow for [model type] serving [traffic pattern]. Include DAG structure, experiment tracking, CI/CD, canary rollout, monitoring, and incident response.

output_examples.input: Plan a pipeline for a churn prediction model.
output_examples.output: A five-stage workflow covering data checks, feature generation, training, validation gates, and canary deployment with rollback criteria.

output: Validation summary with baseline comparison and drift checks.
Deployment plan with shadow traffic, canary limits, and rollback triggers.
Monitoring plan for latency, errors, and model performance.

output_examples.input: Select an orchestration platform for a small team.
output_examples.output: A comparison of Airflow, Dagster, Kubeflow, and Prefect with recommended fit, risks, and implementation steps.

best_practices: Start with a simple linear pipeline, then add validation, monitoring, and rollout controls.
Version data, code, models, metrics, and deployment configurations together.
Define rollback criteria before production traffic reaches a new model.
anti_patterns: Skipping data validation before training or deployment.
Deploying models without baseline comparison, drift checks, or rollback triggers.
Choosing orchestration tools before defining pipeline stages and ownership.

faq.question: Does this skill execute ML pipelines?
faq.answer: No. It provides workflow guidance and planning support. Users run tools and infrastructure in their own environment.

faq.question: Which platforms does it cover?
faq.answer: It discusses Airflow, Dagster, Kubeflow, Prefect, MLflow, Weights & Biases, SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML, and Kubernetes serving.

faq.question: Can it help with data preparation?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers validation, feature engineering, splitting strategies, dataset versioning, and lineage planning.

faq.question: Can it design deployment workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It explains shadow deployment, canary release, blue-green deployment, rollback, monitoring, and production validation.

faq.question: Is it suitable for regulated ML systems?
faq.answer: It can support planning, but teams must add required privacy, security, audit, and governance controls.

faq.question: Does it include complete templates?
faq.answer: The scanned skill file references templates and examples, but it mainly provides guidance rather than a full project scaffold.
